description_en: Enables a firewall policy for a specified simple application server
description_zh: 开启指定轻量应用服务器的一条防火墙策略
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open enable-firewall-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id eeea34d9867b4d55a4ff8d5fcfbd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableFirewallRule

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the specified simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the specified simple application server.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query the list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. A client token is generated from your client and must be unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the firewall rule
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The IP address or CIDR block
parameters.name: source_cidr_ip
